headline: Progressive Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Progressive (NYSE:PGR) used its second-quarter investor event to outline its strategy for expanding in bundled auto and home insurance, emphasizing improvements in its property business and the growth potential among “Robinsons,” its term for consistently insured households that bundle auto and home
